name: Erinys
introduce:
XR-03-E Erinys
A Medium ST jointly developed by UNCS and Obsidian. Nominally the successor to "XR-Rebirth" and "XR-Judgment," its customization philosophy remains singular in purpose: to serve the transformed Rosa Diaz alone. In addition to matrixing the "Mirror Core" mounted on the XR, it also enhances the linkage between assault and tactical weaponry according to Rosa Diaz's personal combat style. Due to anomalous fluctuations observed in XR-03-E's arashi material structure while piloted by Rosa, relevant researchers have already initiated a follow-up investigation. What cannot be denied is this: XR-03-E's rebirth has only one objective—to once again become the blade with which Rosa Diaz passes judgment upon all.

20454.name: Mirror Matrix
20454.SpecificEffects: When attacking, increases DMG based on hits. For every <color=#F74848>1</color> hit, DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>. Resets after attacking.

30348.name: Eruption Mod
30348.SpecificEffects:
When attacking a target within the attack range of both the held weapon and the backpack weapon, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+18%</color>;
Enters the <buf ID=900121>[Restriction Removal]</buf> state, activating the extra module effect integrated within the part.

hiddenModules.name: Restriction Removal
hiddenModules.SpecificEffects:
When Eruption Mod reaches maximum level, activates the Hidden Mod of each part.
Body activates [Mode - Martial]
L-Arm activates [Mode - Moonflower]
R-Arm activates [Mode - Affection]
Legs activate [Mode - Unhurt].

hiddenModules.name: Mode - Martial
hiddenModules.SpecificEffects:
A technological marvel born from the Hyper-Aptamer Experiment.
When initiating combat, has a <color=#F74848>35%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900010>[Gusty Strike]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.4</color>x DMG.

hiddenModules.name: Mode - Moonflower
hiddenModules.SpecificEffects:
A technological marvel born from the Hyper-Aptamer Experiment.
When actively attacking, inflicts <buf ID=7101702>[Armor Down II]</buf> on the target before combat, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

hiddenModules.name: Mode - Affection
hiddenModules.SpecificEffects:
A technological marvel born from the Hyper-Aptamer Experiment.
Aura: Grants DMG <color=#F74848>+6%</color> and Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+3%</color> to allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles.

hiddenModules.name: Mode - Unhurt
hiddenModules.SpecificEffects:
A technological marvel born from the Hyper-Aptamer Experiment.
When the Legs are broken, Movement does not decrease, and it gains the <buf ID=6005461>[Movement Down Immunity]</buf> effect.
